_: Hook formats for coding agents this build has not walked itself. Copy
this file next to the record -- the directory podshl-repairs keeps its
state in, printed by `podshl-repairs measure-agent-hook` -- and keep
only the entries you have something to say about.
Every field is a list of dotted keys, tried in order, in the JSON the
agent sends its hook on standard input. Where you do not know a key,
leave the list empty rather than inventing one: an empty list is a gap
the record can name, a wrong key is a record about the wrong file.
tool     the name of the tool the agent is about to use
shell    those tool names that mean a shell command, not a file write
path     the file a write is about
command  the command a shell call will run
cwd      the directory it runs in, for the relative paths in it
session  what tells one of the agent's sessions from another
call_id  what tells one tool call from another, when there is one
`source` is where you read it. A format from this file is never treated
as measured, whatever it says: the hook commands are printed to put in
by hand, every record it makes says the format was read and not walked,
and every call it cannot read is kept while `measure-agent-hook` is on.
The entries below are shapes to start from, not walked formats. Measure
yours: podshl-repairs measure-agent-hook --agent NAME
